_readme: SERVER-ONLY. Never import this from a page/component. Edit values here (or paste the whole object into the HUNT_ANSWERS_JSON env var to override without committing answers). Matching is case-insensitive and ignores spaces/punctuation. A null answer means 'not filled in yet' and that stage will reject everything. Run `npm run check-content` after editing.
